findings.category: CWE-362 / STRIDE denial of service and evidence integrity
findings.description: Shared write_new creates the visible final path before writing/flushing the complete JSON. Concurrent readers treat existence as completion.
findings.impact: An ordinary poll can make serve decode an empty/partial request, enter failure cleanup and terminate the retained case Job. Signed or fixture-release approval publication can similarly make pinned nativeHarnessWait t.Fatal before complete JSON is visible. This can invalidate an authorized case without a native authority failure.
findings.proof: Interleave writer immediately after open('xb') and before write(raw), then reader's glob/Lstat/read/decode. Empty and partial JSON produce JSONDecodeError; Source exception path cancels the Job. This is an identified source interleaving, not a claimed executed native reproduction.
findings.recommendation: Replace final-path direct writes with same-directory, uniquely named temporary-file write/flush/fsync/close and an atomic no-clobber commit on Windows. Preserve exclusive one-shot consumption and never overwrite an existing final path; clean up only the writer's own temporary file. Readers must observe either absent or complete JSON. Validate with a public deterministic barrier/delayed-writer case before accepting controller lifecycle use.
